purpose: Teach: 野鳥/密室/完走/称さ/代々/比し/戦中/脅かさ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 敷地内の野鳥、保護活動、組み込め。
lines.en: Protect the birds on the grounds. Make it part of what we do.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No softness — this is instruction, not suggestion. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。試験密室を活用した、製品検証、進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll use the test chambers for product validation.
lines.style: Measured, professional acknowledgment. Slight pause after 'understood' — processing the directive. Even pace, steady delivery. Shows he's thinking it through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: マラソン大会、社員、完走できるよう、訓練を支援しろ。
lines.en: The marathon event—make sure every employee can finish. I want training support in place.
lines.style: Direct and even. Emphasis on 'every'—not casual about this. Pauses slightly between clauses. Sounds like someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界で先進企業と称されるよう、努力します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll be recognized as the progressive ones in the industry.
lines.style: Respectful conviction without hesitation. Measured tempo. Suggests he's committing to something he believes in, not just complying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 代々の家訓、企業理念にも反映させたい。
lines.en: The family principles we've inherited—I want them woven into our corporate mission.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pacing. Weight on 'inherited'—this is legacy, not policy. Slightly lower in register, almost reflective despite the directive tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 他社に比し、独自性を出します。
lines.en: We'll set ourselves apart. Our distinctiveness will be clear.
lines.style: Steady, confident affirmation. No apology in the tone. 'Distinctiveness' lands with quiet emphasis—he understands what's being asked and commits to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 戦中の歴史、社史としても残せ。
lines.en: Document the wartime history. Include it in our official record.
lines.style: Formal, spare. Each word weighted equally—this matters. No rush. Sounds like someone preserving something important, not just giving orders.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 企業ブランド、脅かさない運用、徹底します。
lines.en: I'll ensure our brand position stays intact. Operations will be scrupulous.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly more personal in weight. 'Intact' receives quiet emphasis. Calm, professional assurance. Closes the exchange with finality.
